newsitem.title: USA: U.S. rice weekly export sales highlights--USDA.
newsitem.headline: U.S. rice weekly export sales highlights--USDA.

text.p: USDA rice export sales highlights in latest reporting week:

Net sales of 20,200 MT were 9 percent above the week earlier, but 1 percent under the 4-week average. The primary buyers were the Dominican Republic (10,000 MT, which was switched from 1997/98), El Salvador (4,800 MT--all rough), Mexico (2,700 MT, of which 2,100 MT was rough), and Honduras (1,200 MT).

Net sales reductions of 6,300 MT for 1997/98 resulted as major increases for the Netherlands (1,300 MT), the Leeward and Windward Islands (1,300 MT), and Saudi Arabia (1,000 MT) were offset by decreases of 10,000 MT for the Dominican Republic which were switched to 1996/97.

Exports of 35,400 MT were three and one-third times the previous week, but 1 percent under the 4-week average. Turkey (15,500 MT) was the primary destination, with smaller quantities to Mexico (6,500 MT), Honduras (3,600 MT), the United Kingdom (2,300 MT), Canada (1,900 MT), the Netherlands (1,300 MT), Germany (1,200 MT), and Yemen (1,000 MT).
